一句话说清是什么、解决什么
One Kit for All Season Roof Care - No Ladder Needed
Say goodbye to ladder falls and expensive roofing contractors. Reach up to 20FT from the ground to remove snow, leaves, and debris safely.

3 Interchangeable Heads for Every Job: • Snow Scraper (Red): Clear heavy snow from asphalt shingles without scratching • Leaf Broom (Brown Bristle): Sweep leaves and debris off gutters and roof edges • Solar Panel Duster (Blue Fiber): Gentle microfiber duster cleans solar panels without streaks • Plus: Use the duster head for indoor high-reach cleaning (ceiling fans, blinds)

15 Section Detachable Stainless Steel Pole (Each 40cm / 16in) • Total extended length: ~20FT / 6M • Twist-lock sections for secure fit • Detach to shorten for storage • Rust-proof stainless steel construction
Year-Round Use: ❄️ Winter: Snow removal from roof and solar panels 🍂 Fall: Leaf and debris cleanup ☀️ Spring: Solar panel maintenance to maximize efficiency 🏠 Year-round: High-reach indoor dusting
What's in the Box: • 1 x Snow Scraper Head • 1 x Leaf Broom Head • 1 x Solar Panel Duster Head • 15 x Pole Sections • 1 x Ergonomic Handle
No Ladder. No Risk. No Expensive Repairs.
Reach Up to 20FT from the Ground
Complete roof maintenance in one kit. Designed for homeowners who want safe, effective roof care without climbing ladders or hiring professionals.
Q: Will this scratch my roof shingles? A: The snow scraper is designed with a curved edge that glides over shingles. Always use with light pressure and avoid aggressive scraping.
